prd.title: Settings Page
prd.overview: The Settings Page is operator preferences: theme (light/dark via [data-theme]), locale (EN/BN persisted in IDB), notification preferences (in-app vs SMS), and Reset. Closes MAJOR #3: Reset → ghost variant + confirmation modal. Reset clears IDB and emits SettingsReset event. Tier 3 (light).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/Settings.tsx (278 LOC); theme + locale + notification prefs; MAJOR #3: Reset ghost variant + confirmation modal

requirement.title: Mount route at /settings for utility_operator
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for utility_operator.

requirement.title: Theme toggle (light/dark via [data-theme])
requirement.description: Render theme toggle (light/dark). Setting [data-theme] attribute on root element. Preference persists in IDB.

requirement.title: Locale preference (EN/BN; IDB-persisted)
requirement.description: Render locale preference (EN/BN radio or toggle). Preference persists in IDB via i18next-browser-languagedetector.

requirement.title: Notification preferences (in-app toast vs SMS)
requirement.description: Render notification preferences: in-app toast (on/off), SMS (on/off). Preferences persist in IDB.

requirement.title: MAJOR #3: Reset is ghost variant + confirmation modal
requirement.description: Reset button uses ghost variant (NOT destructive). Click opens confirmation modal: "Reset all settings? This cannot be undone." On confirm, clears IDB preferences and emits SettingsReset{actor} event. Closes MAJOR #3 from 02-phase-4-closeout.md §4.3.

acceptance.criterion: Reset button is ghost variant (not destructive)

requirement.title: MSW: SettingsReset event handler
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts POST /api/events to accept SettingsReset event type. Persist via idb-keyval.

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: settings-page, …-header, …-main, …-theme-toggle, …-locale-preference, …-notification-preferences, …-notification-in-app, …-notification-sms, …-button-reset, …-reset-confirmation-modal, …-reset-confirm, …-reset-cancel.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for theme labels, locale labels, notification options, reset confirmation. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: MAJOR #3 reconciliation: ghost variant + confirmation modal
requirement.description: Verify Reset button uses ghost variant (not destructive); verify confirmation modal copy matches spec; verify SettingsReset event payload.

acceptance.criterion: Reset button class includes ghost variant (not destructive)
Modal copy matches "Reset all settings? This cannot be undone."
SettingsReset event fires with actor field

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Toggle theme; assert [data-theme] attribute changes. Reload; assert preference persists. Theme toggle works.
Click Reset; assert confirmation modal opens. Confirm; intercept POST /api/events; assert SettingsReset event. Verify IDB cleared. Reset flow works; modal + event + IDB clear.
